notes_for_editor: Single source: the NHLR register page. The eastern_us_lookouts page cached for this tower holds only a title and a Mississippi lookouts heading, so it is not cited. The record's status 'standing' is not stated by the register; the 2022 visit is the latest evidence. No Wikipedia article for the place was found (404). Current condition, access and the date the MFC stopped using the site are all unknown.
